response.original_title: 『!!Suite-Booking-FAQs!!』How can I reserve an extra suite on my Norwegian cruise?
response.overview: To add a room on a Norwegian Cruise Line, you must call their customer service at +1-888-512-8367 or +44-120-420-8151 or contact your travel agent. To add someone to a room on Norwegian Cruise Line , you must contact customer service directly +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada)or speak with your travel agent. Additions cannot be made online or through the mobile app, and are subject to your current stateroom's capacity limit, total ship capacity, and lifeboat availability. If you need direct assistance, the quickest way to get help is by calling Norwegian Cruise Line customer service at +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada). Their expert representatives can guide you through the process, confirm room availability, and explain any additional costs involved. Understanding Norwegian Cruise Line Room Occupancy Rules Before attempting to add someone to your stateroom, it’s important to understand Norwegian Cruise Line occupancy policies.
